data.one_liner: Flutter widget for inputting and editing vehicle license plate numbers.
data.what_it_does: Provides input fields and custom keyboards for entering license plate numbers with built-in patterns for China, Korea, the US, and Japan. Supports light and dark styles, custom validation rules, and per-position editing.
use_when: You need to build a vehicle-related application requiring specialized license plate inputs.
You want country-specific keyboard layouts and formatting rules for plate numbers.
avoid_when: You only need standard text fields without specialized vehicle plate keyboards.
Your target use case does not involve vehicle registrations or license plates.
strengths: Includes built-in plate patterns for China, Korea, the US, and Japan.
Supports customized light and dark styles or fully custom themes.
Provides data-driven slot rules and keyboard layouts.
weaknesses: Limited to vehicle license plate input use cases.
data.minimal_example:
PlateInputField(
  placeHolder: '沪A12345',
  styles: PlateStyles.light,
  inputFieldWidth: 40,
  inputFieldHeight: 54,
  autoCompleteLength: 7,
  onChanged: (List<String> array, String value) {},
)
